text: {"lessons":["My account has risen overall despite several down periods, but this short record does not show that any particular trade caused the gains or losses.","Selling Stock B after a large gain and later buying more shares shows why I should avoid reacting to price moves alone; prices are random and past performance does not predict future returns.","I should keep decisions aligned with my long-term plan and diversification, while managing downside risk without letting loss aversion drive impulsive trading."]}
